captions.accounting: Equal logical work and distinct memory/accounting scopes for all ten lifecycles. Each lifecycle records 128,811,263,616 logical checkpoint-reader bytes and 128,811,927,312 facade H2D bytes over its 12 requests: equal across modes, not equal to each other (H2D minus reader is 663,696 bytes). Every arm records 40,943 verified reads, zero wasted read bytes, and zero unknown read counts/bytes in the read-pipeline ledger. These application counters are not physical backend I/O or bus traffic. The owner-lifetime logical host-reservation maximum is 16,777,984 bytes (16.000732 MiB) against a 64 MiB logical limit; it is not RSS. Separately, the device-wide sampled maximum is 4,125 MiB against a configured 7 GiB target in every arm; it is neither an exact continuous peak nor exact process-owned GPU bytes. Bars are common observed maxima, never sums of lifetime peaks; do not add PSS, logical reservations, and device memory. Request-period shared NFS-client serverreadbytes are 314,825,320 for P1 blocking and recorded zero for the other nine arms. P1 blocking individual request windows sum to 312,732,264 bytes; the remaining 2,093,056 bytes lie between those windows within the enclosing shared-client phase. Fresh servers do not establish cold NFS/page caches, and shared-client counters do not identify physical NAS backend traffic. Startup/shutdown PID-I/O deltas remain unobserved (null), not zero. Zero final logical charges do not prove universal physical release. MiB and GiB denote 2^20 and 2^30 bytes.
captions.latency: Client latency and quality-qualified goodput in the sealed five-block paired-read study. Each connected arm value is the median of five measured-QA requests; the independent resampling unit is the paired block (n=5), not the 50 requests. B (blue circles) is blocking and L (teal squares) is lookahead. Rows retain the frozen execution orders P1 B/L, P2 B/L, P3 L/B, P4 L/B, P5 B/L. The log-scale ratio panel shows each block (circles B/L, triangles L/B), unity, and the aggregate exp(median log(L/B)) as a diamond. E2E, TTFT, and goodput ratios are 0.91823, 0.88755, and 1.10908. Gray strips and bracketed numbers are descriptive nearest-rank 2.5/97.5 percentile ranges from all 3,125 ordered paired-block bootstrap resamples (ranks 79 and 3047), not coverage-guaranteed confidence intervals or significance tests. Goodput is 40 actual quality-qualified completion tokens divided by the sum of five client E2E durations per arm. Startup launch-to-ready probe times are separate and excluded from request latency. This single instrumented study supports no repetition-based confidence, power, or SOTA claim.
captions.read-wait: Read-demand wait and client-latency changes in the same five paired blocks. Each request wait is the sum of its anchored per-invocation host demand_wait_ns deltas, converted to seconds; each arm is the median of five measured-QA request waits. Connected points show blocking (blue circles) and lookahead (teal squares), with frozen execution order beside each block. The right panel plots lookahead-minus-blocking differences of the arm medians for request wait and client E2E; labels and circle/triangle markers retain order. All five blocks have lower observed wait and lower E2E with lookahead. This is an association consistent with less waiting, not proof that wait reduction caused the critical-path latency change. Host wait intervals are not CUDA timelines, are not additive to client latency, and do not establish GPU overlap. No fitted trend, causal coefficient, or extra independent replicates are inferred; shared-client/cache conditions remain a limitation.

design.startup_scope: recorded launch-to-ready probe; not lifecycle elapsed time or a request

interpretation.accounting: Logical reader and facade H2D request-period totals per lifecycle; equal between modes, not equal to each other. Not physical backend or PCIe traffic.
interpretation.bootstrap: Exact 3125 paired-block resamples; nearest ranks 79 and 3047; descriptive, not coverage-guaranteed
interpretation.cache: Shared NFS client counters; fresh server is not a cold cache. P1 blocking has nonzero serverreadbytes, other arms record zero.
interpretation.limitations: One sealed instrumented exploratory n=5 study; no significance, power, repetition-based confidence, SOTA, physical-release or backend-I/O claim.
interpretation.memory: Owner-lifetime logical host reservation maximum and device-wide sampled maximum have separate scopes. Neither is RSS; do not add PSS or sum lifetime peaks.
interpretation.quality: 900 worker-enqueued token IDs joined to HTTP IDs; 110 exact eight-token oracles and 10 length-only two-token smokes. SSE events are not token boundaries.
interpretation.wait: Sum per-invocation host demand_wait_ns within each measured request, then median of five requests per arm. Association, not GPU-overlap or critical-path causality proof.

qualified_goodput_tokens_per_second.interpretation: 2.5/97.5 percentile descriptive range; no coverage or significance claim
